title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Gomathi feels relieved as Raji and Meena reconcile after the conflict. Meanwhile, Sakthivel strongly objects to Muthuvel's decision to give Palanivel the house as his share.

title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Nila turns Chozhan's teasing into a playful battle of wits. Meanwhile, Vannathi's questions about Pandian's new two-wheeler spark tension.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Devika surprises Manoj by promising him property and arranging his wedding night with Kanaga. Later, Kanaga's fear of the dark leaves Manoj struggling to handle her demands.

title: Super Singer Junior
description: The dedication round celebrates inspiring bonds through heartfelt songs and meaningful gifts. Contestants honour their loved ones with emotional performances and gratitude.

title: Cooku With Comali
description: The Comalis kick off the show by choosing their cooks through entertaining get-up acts. The fun continues as they hunt for ingredients based on their cooks' clever clues.
